events.title: Austin Bhet — December 2024
events.description: The first Austin Bhet professional gathering. Attendees met in person to share what they do for a living or hope to do next, followed by short community presentations on topics including artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and professional networking.
events.source: Date and URL from project owner. Description summarized from the organizers' planning document recap (topics only).
